ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel dominance with a high contrast ratio relative to isolated high-intensity (white) localized clusters; approximately 95:5 dark-to-light distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity micro-blobs (white) are uniformly scattered across the ventral surface; a significant contiguous high-intensity cluster is mapped to the distal extremity of the right lobe; linear high-intensity streak located on the medial-left lobe near the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees, showing significant depth relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-10 pixels along the entire continuous boundary; prominent jagged peak at the distal end of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex outer trajectory curving upward toward distal tips; trailing edge displays a smooth concave curve from the notch before transitioning to serrated convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular high-contrast clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes and along the leading edges, consistent with barnacle-induced pixel disruptions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine-scale vertical linear disruptions of lower intensity (gray) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe and central-lower portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring and irregular topography on the right lobe tip; frayed/ragged pixel boundary on the left lobe tip suggesting historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellow-toned pixel clusters (n=3) observed on the mid-section of the left lobe, distinct from white scarring patterns.
